title: Packaging and Reproducible Use
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of pyproject, requirements, and downloaded assets, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in sign-language-to-text-translation.
learning_objectives: Explain pyproject, requirements, and downloaded assets in plain language and connect it to sign_language_translator/cli.py; pyproject.toml; WORKFLOW.md.
Trace one input through the packaging and reproducible use stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the packaging and reproducible use stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for pyproject, requirements, and downloaded assets.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
